arxiv-2011-13981.title: Thermal order in large N conformal gauge theories
arxiv-2011-13981.creator: Soumyadeep Chaudhuri, ​, Changha Choi, ​, Eliezer Rabinovici
arxiv-2011-13981.description: Abstract In this work we explore the possibility of spontaneous breaking of global symmetries at all nonzero temperatures for conformal field theories (CFTs) in D = 4 D=4 space-time dimensions. We show that such a symmetry-breaking indeed occurs in certain families of non-supersymmetric large N gauge theories at a planar limit.

arxiv-2106-11216.title: Multi-messenger heavy-ion collision physics
arxiv-2106-11216.creator: Charles Gale, Jean-François Paquet, Björn Schenke, Chun Shen
arxiv-2106-11216.description: Abstract This work studies the production of direct photons in relativistic nuclear collisions, along with the production of hadrons. Radiation from the very first instants to the final moments of the evolution is included. The hybrid model used here describes all stages of relativistic heavy-ion collisions.

arxiv-2203-14086.title: Getting more from the skyline operator through restricted skylines, regret minimizing sets and skyline ordering: a survey on their properties and comparison
arxiv-2203-14086.creator: Claudio Migliorelli
arxiv-2203-14086.description: Abstract Given a set of multidimensional points, the skyline operator returns a set of potentially interesting points from such a dataset. This popular operator filters out a set of tuples that are not dominated by other ones, reducing the size of a possibly large initial dataset.

arxiv-2305-18229.title: Dynamical Symmetries of the H Atom, One of the Most Important Tools Of Modern Physics: SO(4) to SO(4,2), Background, Theory, and Use in Calculating Radiative Shifts
arxiv-2305-18229.creator: G. Jordan Maclay
arxiv-2305-18229.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by G. Jordan Maclay. Understanding the hydrogen atom has been at the heart of modern physics. Exploring the symmetry of the most fundamental two body system has led to advances in atomic physics, quantum mechanics, quantum electrodynamics, and elementary particle physics. In this pedagogic review we present an integrated treatment of the symmetries of the Schrodinger hydrogen atom, including the classical atom, the SO(4) degeneracy group, the non-invariance group or spectrum generating group SO(4,1) and the expanded group SO(4,2).

arxiv-2312-13439.title: Active particle in one dimension subjected to resetting with memory
arxiv-2312-13439.creator: Denis Boyer, Satya N. Majumdar
arxiv-2312-13439.description: Abstract The study of diffusion with preferential returns to places visited in the past has attracted an increased attention in recent years. In these highly non-Markov processes, a standard diffusive particle intermittently resets at a given rate to previously visited positions.

arxiv-2403-10439.title: Optimized Search for a Binary Black Hole Merger Population in LIGO-Virgo O3 Data
arxiv-2403-10439.creator: Praveen Kumar, Thomas Dent
arxiv-2403-10439.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Praveen Kumar, Thomas Dent. Maximizing the number of detections in matched filter searches for CBC ( CBC ) GW ( GW ) signals requires a model of the source population distribution. In previous searches using the PyCBC framework, sensitivity to the population of BBH ( BBH ) mergers was improved by restricting the range of filter template mass ratios and use of a simple one-dimensional population model.

arxiv-2405-20900.title: Large Language Models: A New Approach for Privacy Policy Analysis at Scale
arxiv-2405-20900.creator: David Rodriguez, Ian Yang, Jose M. Del Alamo, Norman Sadeh
arxiv-2405-20900.description: Abstract The number and dynamic nature of web and mobile applications presents significant challenges for assessing their compliance with data protection laws. In this context, symbolic and statistical Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques have been employed for the automated analysis of these systems’ privacy policies.

arxiv-2503-08923.title: Enhancing Large Language Models for Hardware Verification: A Novel SystemVerilog Assertion Dataset
arxiv-2503-08923.creator: Anand Menon, Samit S Miftah, Shamik Kundu, Souvik Kundu, Amisha Srivastava, Arnab Raha, Gabriel T Sonnenschein, Suvadeep Banerjee, Deepak Mathaikutty, Kanad Basu
arxiv-2503-08923.description: Abstract . Hardware verification is crucial in modern SoC design, consuming around 70% of development time. SystemVerilog assertions ensure correct functionality. However, existing industrial practices rely on manual efforts for assertion generation, which becomes increasingly untenable as hardware systems become complex. Recent research shows that Large Language Models (LLMs) can automate this process.

arxiv-2504-09044.title: On quadratic Novikov algebras
arxiv-2504-09044.creator: Xiaofeng Dong, Yanyong Hong
arxiv-2504-09044.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Xiaofeng Dong, Yanyong Hong. A quadratic Novikov algebra is a Novikov algebra ( A , ∘ ) (A,\circ) with a symmetric and nondegenerate bilinear form B ⁡ ( ⋅ , ⋅ ) B(\cdot,\cdot) satisfying B ⁡ ( a ∘ b , c ) = − B ⁡ ( b , a ∘ c + c ∘ a ) B(a\circ b,c)=-B(b,a\circ c+c\circ a) for all a a , b b , c ∈ A c\in A .

arxiv-2506-14523.title: Several types of quantum Wasserstein distance based on an optimization over separable states
arxiv-2506-14523.creator: Géza Tóth, József Pitrik
arxiv-2506-14523.description: Abstract We consider several definitions of the quantum Wasserstein distance based on an optimization over general bipartite quantum states with given marginals. Then, we examine the quantities obtained after the optimization is carried out over bipartite separable states instead. We prove that several of these quantities are equal to each other. Thus, we connect several approaches in the literature.

pmc-10701242.title: Glutamine addiction and therapeutic strategies in pancreatic cancer
pmc-10701242.creator: Lin-Lin Ren, Tao Mao, Pin Meng, Li Zhang, Hong-Yun Wei, Zi-Bin Tian
pmc-10701242.description: Pancreatic cancer remains one of the most lethal diseases worldwide owing to its late diagnosis, early metastasis, and poor prognosis. Because current therapeutic options are limited, there is an urgent need to investigate novel targeted treatment strategies. Pancreatic cancer faces significant metabolic challenges, principally hypoxia and nutrient deprivation, due to specific microenvironmental constraints, including an extensive desmoplastic stromal reaction.

pmc-11360004.title: Optimization of a Modular Nanotransporter Design for Targeted Intracellular Delivery of Photosensitizer
pmc-11360004.creator: Rena T Alieva, Alexey V Ulasov, Yuri V Khramtsov, Tatiana A Slastnikova, Tatiana N Lupanova, Maria A Gribova, Georgii P Georgiev, Andrey A Rosenkranz, Murali Mohan Yallapu
pmc-11360004.description: Modular nanotransporters (MNTs) are drug delivery systems for targeted cancer treatment. As MNTs are composed of several modules, they offer the advantage of high specificity and biocompatibility in delivering drugs to the target compartment of cancer cells. The large carrier module brings together functioning MNT modules and serves as a platform for drug attachment.

The purpose of this study was to find out whether there are differences in dental anxiety using the Dental Anxiety Scale, their level of psychological distress using the Brief Symptom Inventory-18 and the evaluation of oral health among Albanian and German patients.MethodsThis study was conducted in the period from December 2019 to July 2020, a sample of N = 263

pmc-11667639.title: Optimization of extrusion conditions for development of high quality rice-lupin-pumpkin based extruded snack food
pmc-11667639.creator: Yeshambel Dagnaw Alefew, Abebaw Teshome Tiruneh, Tadesse Fenta Yehuala
pmc-11667639.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study was examined to optimize extrusion conditions (barrel temperature, feed moisture, and blending ratios of rice, lupin, and pumpkin flour) during processing high-quality extruded products using a twin-screw extruder. A three-factor with three-level response surface methodology with a Box-Behnken design, was applied to evaluate the effects of selected processing conditions: blending ratios of lupin (10–20 %), barrel temperature (115–155 °C) and feed moisture content (14–20 %) on the functional, nutritional and sensory characteristics of the produced snack food.

pmc-12713030.title: Bridged Conductive Nanofibrous Membrane Overcoming the Porosity‐Conductivity Trade‐Off for Electrothermal Air Purification
pmc-12713030.creator: Xiaoxue Yao, Zhenwen Zhang, Wei Deng, Chuhan Feng, Qili Xu, Wenzhu Lin, Zehua Peng, Yang Cao, Wang Guo, Bee Luan Khoo, Steven Wang
pmc-12713030.description: Emerging conductive porous materials hold remarkable promise for Joule‐heating applications like electothermal filtration, smart textiles, and energy management due to their porous and conductive synergy. However, their development is constrained by a design trade‐off between achieving high porosity for efficient flow transmission and maintaining a conductive network for effective charge transport.

pmc-13224315.title: Does the brain’s E:I balance really shape long-range temporal correlations? Lessons learned from 3T MRI
pmc-13224315.creator: Lydia Sochan, Jessica Archibald, Alexander Mark Weber
pmc-13224315.description: A 3T multimodal MR study of healthy adults (n = 18; 10 female; 21.3–53.4 years) was performed to investigate the relationship between functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) long-range temporal correlations and excitatory/inhibitory balance (via single voxel magnetic resonance spectroscopy measurements of glutamate and γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA)).
